Math.question: 1) Interest obtained on a sum of ৳ 5000 for 3 years is ৳ 1500. Find the rate percent.
Math.exp:
Let rate is R%
We have,
I = PTR/100
Here, 1500 = (5000×3×R)/100
Thus, R = 10%

Math.question: 2) What is the difference between the simple interest on a principal of ৳ 500 being calculated at 5% per annum for 3 years and 4% per annum for 4 years?
Math.exp:
I1 = PT1R1/100
I1 = (500×3×5)/100 = ৳ 75
I2 = PT2R2/100
I2 = (500×4×4)/100 = ৳ 80
Difference = 80−75 = ৳ 5

Math.question: 3) In what time will ৳ 3300 becomes ৳ 3399 at 6% per annum interest compounded half-yearly?
Math.exp:
P = ৳ 3300
A = ৳ 3399
R = 6% per annum
Let the time be n years.
Compound interest is taken half - yearly.
A = P×[1+((R/2)×100)]2n
3399 = 3300(1+(3/100))2n
(1.03)2n = 33993300
(1.03)2n = (1.03)1
Thus, 2n = 1 year
n = 1/2 year = 6 months

Math.question: 4) A sum was invested at simple interest at a certain interest for 2 years. It would have fetched ৳ 60 more had it been invested at 2% higher rate. What was the sum?
Math.exp:
Let the rate be R at which Principal P is invested for 2 years.
According to question,
{Interest at Rate (R + 2)}% - (interest at rate R%) = ৳ 60
(P×2×(R+2))/100 − (P×2×R)/100 = 60
(2PR+4P−2PR)/100 = 60
4P = 60×100
Or, P = (60×100)/4
Hence, P = ৳ 1500

Math.question: 12) Two numbers are in ratio 4 : 5 and their LCM is 180. The smaller number is-
Math.exp:
Let two numbers be 4x and 5x
Their LCM = 180 and HCF = x
Now,
1st number × 2nd number = LCM × HCF
Or, 4x × 5x = 180 × x
Or, 20x = 180
Or, x = 9
Then, the smaller number = 4 × 9 = 36

9x - 15y - 10x + 15y = 3000 - 5000
Or, -x = -2000

Math.question: 21) A man takes 6 hours 15 minutes in walking a distance and riding back to starting place. He could walk both ways in 7 hours 45 minutes. The time taken by him to ride back both ways is:

Math.question: 23) Running at 5/4 of his usual speed, an athlete improves his timing by 5 minutes. The time he usually takes to run the same distance is:

⇒ 1/5 × Usual time = 5 minutes
Usual time = 25 minutes.

Math.question: 44) An error 2% in excess is made while measuring the side of a square. The percentage of error in the calculated area of the square is:
Math.exp:
100 cm is read as 102 cm.
∴ A1 = (100 x 100) cm2 and A2 (102 x 102) cm2
(A2 - A1) = [(102)2 - (100)2]
= (102 + 100) x (102 - 100)
= 404 cm2
∴ Percentage error
= ((404/(100×100))×100)%
= 4.04%

Math.question: 45) A rectangular park 60 m long and 40 m wide has two concrete crossroads running in the middle of the park and rest of the park has been used as a lawn. If the area of the lawn is 2109 sq. m, then what is the width of the road?
Math.exp:

Area of the lawn = 2109 m2
∴ Area of the crossroads = (2400 - 2109) m2 = 291 m2
Let the width of the road be x metres. Then,
60 x + 40 x - x 2 = 291
⇒ x 2 - 100 x + 291 = 0
⇒ ( x - 97)( x - 3) = 0
⇒ x = 3 m
